privacy.title: Your pictures stay with you
privacy.p1: The camera picture goes only to this phone or computer. Facemaker draws the funny face right here.
privacy.p2: Nothing is sent to the internet. There are no accounts and no tracking.
privacy.p3: A photo leaves the device only when you tap share and pick a friend or an app.
privacy.p4: Facemaker does not keep your photos. A saved photo goes where you send it: your downloads or the app you pick.
